description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader dedicated to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Your leadership will be crucial in driving quality outcomes, optimizing financial performance, and enhancing the resident experience.This full-time position offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare environment. If you are a results-oriented administrator with a passion for senior care, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Strong leadership, financial management, and interpersonal communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
